Hi!

We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. Your role

  • Create engaging marketing materials for offline and online usage, e.g., flyers, Dialogposts, postcards, campaign banners, ensuring they convey Coffee Circle’s key brand messages to our audience

  • Develop design concepts that relate to our target group and oversee their execution, aligning with key internal stakeholders

  • Handle in-house production of design items and coordinate external production  

  • Ensure creative alignment with our brand standards across all design elements 

  • Report to our Head of Marketing and Revenue and work closely with our seven-person Marketing Team.

Your profile

  • Currently enrolled in a design-related university program, such as Communication or Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a similar field

  • Proficient in design software, with strong experience in InDesign and knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) and Figma.

  • Hands-on experience with communication design and a developed eye for detail

  • Capable of transforming design requests into performant marketing assets

  • Creative, organized, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure designs align with our brand standards

  • Fluency in English and German (min. C1 level in both languages)

  • Ability to work on-site at our office in Berlin-Wedding. We expect working students to work at least once a week from our office.

And this is what you will get from us

  • Flexible working hours. Our core working hours are from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM, but of course we understand that Working Students have different needs

  • Discounts on our coffee and accessories, as well as access to online voucher platforms like Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.

  • Access to platforms for mental and physical health, such as nilohealth, and the possibility to have access to Urban Sports Club M membership after 1 year with us.  

  • The best coffee in the office and quarterly coffee vouchers to enjoy your favorite drink at home with your loved ones.

  • Regular All-Hands meetings, coffee training, and interdisciplinary team events.

What we believe in

We are a purpose-driven organization. For us, growth means increasing our social impact in coffee cooperatives around the world and opening a new world of coffee to our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and compassion to build strong and innovative teams. We cultivate a humble and playful mindset to create an endless learning experience for our team.

No matter your ethnicity, skin color, descent, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity – if the job description fits you, we can’t wait to meet you.

A fast-growing, Y Combinator–backed AI SaaS startup is looking for an Account Executive to join their Munich-based team on-site. The company builds AI-powered software that automates quoting and order processing for distributors and manufacturers — helping sales teams eliminate manual work, reduce lost deals, and close faster.

As an early AE, you'll own the full sales cycle from first meeting to close, selling to mid-market and enterprise customers primarily in Germany. You'll play a pivotal role in driving the company toward a significant ARR milestone by end of 2026, and have the opportunity to help build out the sales team and processes as the company scales.

  • Sales Execution: Conduct product demos, lead negotiations, and close deals while continuously refining the sales process.

  • Sales Strategy: Design and implement strategies to win key accounts and expand into new markets and verticals.

  • Customer Feedback: Gather and relay customer insights to the engineering team to inform and accelerate product development.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS or tech sales.

  • Experience owning end-to-end sales cycles: discovery, demos, negotiations, and close.

  • Proficiency with CRM and sales automation tools (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent) for pipeline management and forecasting.

  • Ability to build and present business cases and ROI models to executive-level stakeholders.

  • Native German and fluent English — both are required.

  • Based in Munich or willing to relocate; this is a fully on-site role.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in construction, supply chain, HVAC, electrical, building materials, or the trades.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: €70,000 – €130,000 per year (OTE or base range; exact structure discussed during the process).

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.

We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

As a Software Integration & Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bringing together complex software systems that power our next generation of autonomous maritime platforms. Working across multiple engineering disciplines, you will integrate, configure, validate, and test software components on prototype vessels and mission systems, ensuring they perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.


Your mission

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, thrives in fast-paced engineering environments, and wants to see their work tested where it truly matters - at sea.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate internally developed and third-party software onto autonomous maritime platforms and prototype vessels.
  • Configure, deploy and validate software across Linux-based systems.
  • Plan and execute system integration and end-to-end testing activities.
  • Support sea trials by diagnosing software and system-level issues in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Investigate defects, reproduce issues and coordinate fixes across software disciplines.
  • Develop scripts and tooling to improve deployment, testing and system configuration.
  • Work closely with Software, Robotics, Autonomy, Systems and Platform Engineers to ensure reliable software releases.
  • Maintain high engineering standards, documentation and version control throughout the integration lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • Degree (or equivalent qualification) in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of Linux operating systems and system configuration.
  • Experience with scripting (Python, Bash or similar).
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Understanding of software engineering principles, software testing and debugging.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working across multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, hands-on approach.
  • Previous experience with software integration, embedded systems or robotics is beneficial but not essential.
  • travel may be required


Nice to have

  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics or unmanned vehicles.
  • Familiarity with networking, distributed systems or middleware.
  • Exposure to hardware/software integration.
  • Experience supporting field trials or operational testing.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.

Our Commitment to the Armed Forces Community

We are proud to hold the Bronze Award from the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS), reflecting our meaningful commitment and ongoing support for UK defence personnel. At our core, we believe in championing those who serve, those who have served, and their families. As part of this scheme, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive, supportive environment where members of the Armed Forces community can thrive and bring their invaluable skills to our team.

​For more ​details please reach out to

raw.description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Omaze is a subscription-first fundraising platform with over 1.2 million active subscribers. We run large-scale prize draws that change people's lives — and we need flawless payments infrastructure behind every one. This role is the operational heartbeat of that infrastructure: owning reconciliation, dunning, vendor relationships, and the day-to-day health of our payments ecosystem. Looking for someone immediately available.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

CORE PAYMENTS OPS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor payment success rates, failure trends, and processor health dashboards daily

  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions, chargebacks, and disputes end-to-end

  • Own the subscriber payment lifecycle from authorisation through to settlement

  • Manage refund workflows and ensure timely, accurate processing

  • Maintain internal runbooks and escalation protocols for payment incidents

DUNNING & RECOVERY

Failed Payment Recovery

  • Own and continuously optimise the full dunning cycle — retry logic, timing, and messaging

  • Analyse decline reason codes and apply segmented retry strategies accordingly

  • Collaborate with CRM and Product to improve pre-dunning communications

  • Test and iterate dunning cadences using A/B frameworks where available

RECONCILIATION

Financial Accuracy

  • Run daily and monthly reconciliation across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions at 1.2M-subscriber scale

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between processor reports and internal records

  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation tooling in partnership with Engineering or BI

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

Stripe & Shopify

  • Serve as the primary internal owner for both Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions relationships

  • Manage configuration, feature adoption, account health, and platform update impact assessments across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions

  • Lead regular vendor reviews and negotiate on SLAs, fees, and product roadmap alignment

  • Evaluate alternative or complementary payment tools as the business scales

REPORTING & INSIGHT

Performance Intelligence

  • Produce weekly and monthly payments performance report for Finance and leadership, covering reconciliation sign-off, authorisation rates, payment-failure churn, recovery performance, and net revenue recovered

  • Maintain a payment ops dashboard that gives real-time visibility to key stakeholders

  • Surface actionable insight from decline and recovery data to inform product, CRM, and commercial decisions

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL

Collaboration & Compliance

  • Partner with Product to shape payment-related feature development and releases

  • Support compliance with PCI-DSS requirements and internal data handling policies

  • Brief Customer Support on payment issues affecting member experience

🤩 About You

  • Experience in a payments, fintech, or subscription operations role

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe, including billing, radar, and reporting APIs

  • Proven ownership of a dunning or failed-payment recovery programme

  • Experience running reconciliation at scale (>100k transactions/month)

  • Strong data skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets

  • Ability to read and interpret processor reporting and settlement files

  • Excellent attention to detail and a low tolerance for unexplained discrepancies

  • Clear written communicator able to brief both technical and non-technical audiences

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO'LL THRIVE HERE

  • Relentlessly precise. At 1.2 million subscribers, small error rates become big numbers fast. You're the person who notices the discrepancy everyone else missed and doesn't rest until it's explained.

  • Recovery-minded. You don't just run the dunning process — you obsess over why cards fail, segment your retries intelligently, and find percentage points of recovery others leave behind.

  • A confident vendor partner. You build strong relationships with Stripe and Shopify account teams, know how to escalate effectively, and hold vendors accountable to SLAs without burning bridges.

  • Process-builder, not just process-follower. You inherit some workflows and build others from scratch. You're comfortable creating runbooks, automating repetitive checks, and leaving things better than you found them.

  • Clear under pressure. When a payment incident lands at pace, you triage fast, communicate clearly to Finance and leadership, and resolve it without drama.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

raw.description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Omaze is a subscription-first fundraising platform with over 1.2 million active subscribers. We run large-scale prize draws that change people's lives — and we need flawless payments infrastructure behind every one. This role is the operational heartbeat of that infrastructure: owning reconciliation, dunning, vendor relationships, and the day-to-day health of our payments ecosystem.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

CORE PAYMENTS OPS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor payment success rates, failure trends, and processor health dashboards daily

  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions, chargebacks, and disputes end-to-end

  • Own the subscriber payment lifecycle from authorisation through to settlement

  • Manage refund workflows and ensure timely, accurate processing

  • Maintain internal runbooks and escalation protocols for payment incidents

DUNNING & RECOVERY

Failed Payment Recovery

  • Own and continuously optimise the full dunning cycle — retry logic, timing, and messaging

  • Analyse decline reason codes and apply segmented retry strategies accordingly

  • Collaborate with CRM and Product to improve pre-dunning communications

  • Test and iterate dunning cadences using A/B frameworks where available

RECONCILIATION

Financial Accuracy

  • Run daily and monthly reconciliation across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions at 1.2M-subscriber scale

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between processor reports and internal records

  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation tooling in partnership with Engineering or BI

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

Stripe & Shopify

  • Serve as the primary internal owner for both Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions relationships

  • Manage configuration, feature adoption, account health, and platform update impact assessments across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions

  • Lead regular vendor reviews and negotiate on SLAs, fees, and product roadmap alignment

  • Evaluate alternative or complementary payment tools as the business scales

REPORTING & INSIGHT

Performance Intelligence

  • Produce weekly and monthly payments performance report for Finance and leadership, covering reconciliation sign-off, authorisation rates, payment-failure churn, recovery performance, and net revenue recovered

  • Maintain a payment ops dashboard that gives real-time visibility to key stakeholders

  • Surface actionable insight from decline and recovery data to inform product, CRM, and commercial decisions

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL

Collaboration & Compliance

  • Partner with Product to shape payment-related feature development and releases

  • Support compliance with PCI-DSS requirements and internal data handling policies

  • Brief Customer Support on payment issues affecting member experience

🤩 About You

  • Experience in a payments, fintech, or subscription operations role

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe, including billing, radar, and reporting APIs

  • Proven ownership of a dunning or failed-payment recovery programme

  • Experience running reconciliation at scale (>100k transactions/month)

  • Strong data skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets

  • Ability to read and interpret processor reporting and settlement files

  • Excellent attention to detail and a low tolerance for unexplained discrepancies

  • Clear written communicator able to brief both technical and non-technical audiences

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO'LL THRIVE HERE

  • Relentlessly precise. At 1.2 million subscribers, small error rates become big numbers fast. You're the person who notices the discrepancy everyone else missed and doesn't rest until it's explained.

  • Recovery-minded. You don't just run the dunning process — you obsess over why cards fail, segment your retries intelligently, and find percentage points of recovery others leave behind.

  • A confident vendor partner. You build strong relationships with Stripe and Shopify account teams, know how to escalate effectively, and hold vendors accountable to SLAs without burning bridges.

  • Process-builder, not just process-follower. You inherit some workflows and build others from scratch. You're comfortable creating runbooks, automating repetitive checks, and leaving things better than you found them.

  • Clear under pressure. When a payment incident lands at pace, you triage fast, communicate clearly to Finance and leadership, and resolve it without drama.

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About The Role

The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the shared backend services and platform capabilities that Constructor's ML and product teams rely on to develop, deploy, and run machine learning at scale - from model serving (including LLMs) to the specialized storages and data pipelines behind it.

We are a service team by nature: our roadmap is shaped by the needs of product teams, and we succeed when they can move faster with less friction. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is comfortable with, and motivated by this dynamic, and who will take end-to-end ownership of core services.

In the near and mid-term, our focus areas include:

  • Making ML workloads easy to run, scale, and operate for every team

  • Providing self-service, configurable infrastructure components to ML and product teams

  • Owning and evolving core ML services and related pipelines with a high bar for reliability and performance

Challenges you will tackle

  • Design, build, and operate high-load distributed backend services that power the company's ML infrastructure

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core ML services and related data pipelines: from design and implementation to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with ML and product teams to understand their needs and turn them into reliable, reusable platform capabilities

  • Make and defend technical decisions: evaluate trade-offs, design first, and own the outcome

  • Be responsible for what you and your team do

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering

  • Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language)

  • Hands-on experience developing on a public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or with self-managed Kubernetes - AWS is our primary platform, but we're not limited to it

  • Experience designing and building distributed, high-load services and APIs

  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and their trade-offs

  • Design-driven engineering mindset: we're a coding-assistant-friendly environment and expect you to use modern AI tools - but you lead with system design and a strong understanding of their applicability and trade-offs

  • Ownership and proactivity: you can't close your eyes to problems, but are ready to solve them and take responsibility for outcomes

  • You are friendly and willing to help your teammates & others

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Rust (or C/C++/Go) - a strong plus

  • Experience developing or contributing to ML platforms or ML infrastructure - a strong plus

  • Experience setting up and operating any vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector, etc.) - a strong plus

  • Experience with model serving / inference infrastructure, including LLMs

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 💵 Base salary: $80k–$120k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

  • 📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you exceptional and hungry to work in a scaling business through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Sales Development at Andela is more than booking meetings—it's the launchpad for a career in enterprise technology sales. You'll own a territory, build relationships with some of the world's most recognizable companies, and help organizations transform how they build software and AI teams.

From day one, you'll partner closely with experienced Account Executives, own strategic outbound campaigns, and develop the skills to navigate complex enterprise buying committees. You'll be trusted to create pipeline, influence revenue, and become an expert in one of the fastest-growing spaces in technology: AI-powered global talent solutions.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives. Keep us fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favor fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is genuinely worth it. Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for millions of people who have no alternative. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short. Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~132 people including security, data and infrastructure. The CISO will also be reporting to you. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring. Set our vision on AI. We're already shipping AI in production as autonomous voice and digital agents handle over 10 million customer interactions a month across West Africa and we're building tooling so engineers can use coding agents safely inside a large Python monolith. You'll help us be truly AI forward, not just a pragmatic adopter. Support expansion. Wave is growing fast, and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You'll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently. Represent engineering to the company. Wave is unusually transparent: everyone sees monthly update from our CEO. You'll write clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and, when needed, our regulators. Key details Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO. Team: Around ~132 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by a product manager and an engineering manager. Data science and analytics sits in the engineering organization; corporate IT does not for now. Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith.  Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs. Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.  Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets. Requirements You've managed an engineering organization of at least~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew. You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end. You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data. You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly. You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers. You have an actual point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it. You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted. You might be a good fit if you Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade. Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal. Change your mind in public when the evidence changes. Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one. Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure. Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad. Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on  Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.

  • Keep us fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favor fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is genuinely worth it.
  • Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for millions of people who have no alternative. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
  • Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~132 people including security, data and infrastructure. The CISO will also be reporting to you. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring.
  • Set our vision on AI. We're already shipping AI in production as autonomous voice and digital agents handle over 10 million customer interactions a month across West Africa and we're building tooling so engineers can use coding agents safely inside a large Python monolith. You'll help us be truly AI forward, not just a pragmatic adopter.
  • Support expansion. Wave is growing fast, and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You'll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently.
  • Represent engineering to the company. Wave is unusually transparent: everyone sees monthly update from our CEO. You'll write clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and, when needed, our regulators.

Key details

Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO.

Team: Around ~132 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by a product manager and an engineering manager. Data science and analytics sits in the engineering organization; corporate IT does not for now.

Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith. 

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs.

Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package. 

  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets.

Requirements

  • You've managed an engineering organization of at least~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew.
  • You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end.
  • You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data.
  • You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly.
  • You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers.
  • You have an actual point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it.
  • You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade.
  • Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal.
  • Change your mind in public when the evidence changes.
  • Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one.
  • Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad.
  • Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We encourage everyone to apply!</p> <p>If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.</p> <p>If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cIzPP7QJGht5LAGKkRGQP8fxh-Z4Mfph2JhGSvhd8zM/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.y7rpsj7nzave" target="_blank">Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3118 - Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>This is an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our digital-first agency and lead one of the UK's most vibrant, fast-paced, and culturally loved brands: <strong>ITV</strong>.</p> <p>ITV is an absolute powerhouse within the UK’s media and entertainment landscape. They run a highly diverse portfolio of campaigns that shape the national conversation. Your mission is to partner directly with ITV’s senior marketing and strategy teams to build their consumer-facing brand, launch their biggest, most talked-about TV shows—from blockbuster dramas and live sports to cultural phenomena like&nbsp;<em>Love Island</em>—and aggressively drive digital customer acquisition to scale Monthly Active Users (MAUs) on&nbsp;<strong>ITVX</strong>.</p> <p>As the senior strategic and operational lead on this flagship account, you will tackle the thrilling challenges of digital, data, and ad-tech integration to power marketing communications that create a true competitive advantage. This role offers a massive focus on innovation and digital excellence, providing a brilliant opportunity to drive our signature&nbsp;<strong>“wholebrain”</strong>&nbsp;planning philosophy across a high-profile, culturally relevant brand.</p> <p>You will be part of a senior leadership team, working closely with the Managing Partner, Partners, and Digital Directors. You will also collaborate on cross-portfolio agency workstreams and help shape the future of our broader agency product.</p> <p><strong>The Team:</strong>&nbsp;You will lead and inspire a talented, integrated team, typically consisting of Planning Senior Associate Directors, Account Directors, Account Managers, and supporting Planner and Executive resource.</p> <p><strong>Reporting Line:</strong>&nbsp;This role reports directly to the Client Partner.</p> <p><strong>Key Deliverables &amp; Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Leadership &amp; Strategic Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Brand &amp; Growth Delivery:</strong>&nbsp;Take overall responsibility for the quality of the work exiting the agency. Ensure all media plans are first-class, insight-led, and masterfully balance high-impact show launches with sophisticated digital acquisition strategies to drive ITVX streaming growth.</li> <li><strong>Client Satisfaction &amp; PRF Delivery:</strong>&nbsp;Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior ITV stakeholders. Payroll Analyst

Location: Basingstoke [hybrid]

Contract: Permanent [Full time or part time, hours negotiable]

Salary: £30,000 to £45,000 depending on experience [pro rata for part time hours]

Start date: As soon as possible

About the role

Hawk-Eye has built a business on getting things exactly right, first time, under pressure, with everyone watching. Payroll works to the same standard. It's the process nobody notices until it goes wrong, and making sure that never happens is what this role exists to do.

As our Payroll Analyst, you'll own payroll from end to end and make sure every colleague is paid accurately and on time, every time.

It's a hands-on role with genuine scope to shape how we work. Alongside running the monthly cycle, you'll be central to improving our payroll processes and implementing a new payroll provider, so you'll be building the setup we run on next as well as the one we run on now.

We're keen to move quickly. We'd like the successful candidate to start in early autumn with a full handover from the person currently in post, so we're especially interested in hearing from people who are immediately available or on a short notice period. We're happy to talk about part time hours for the right person.

What you'll be doing

  • Coordinating end to end payroll processing across the full monthly cycle

  • Making sure payroll inputs, reports, calculations and employee changes are accurate, complete and submitted on time

  • Maintaining payroll data and documentation, and reconciling payroll reports

  • Ensuring compliance with tax and employment legislation, GDPR and internal controls

  • Managing pensions and other benefits, including joiners, leavers and contribution changes

  • Responding to payroll queries promptly and professionally, delivering an excellent service to employees and stakeholders across the business

  • Providing information for compliance submissions, audits, PSA and ONS returns

  • Supporting payroll improvements and the implementation of a new payroll provider

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Experience in payroll processing

  • Strong knowledge of payroll legislation, statutory requirements and compliance obligations

  • Strong attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy

  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach

Desirable

  • Experience automating payroll processes and implementing new payroll providers

  • Experience using payroll systems

Equal Opportunity Employer
Hawk-Eye is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all
employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion,

desirable. environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Curiosity and enthusiasm for financial systems, technology, and continuous process improvement.</li> <li>Strong
